turns.customer: If I book a luxury suite for the end of January and my trip gets cancelled, how much notice do I need to give, and is there a fee?
blocks:
For a **non-holiday** dog boarding stay in a Luxury Suite, the published policy requires at least **24 hours’ notice before the first day of boarding**. If you cancel later than that—or don’t show—the fee is **$35 per suite**. ([happytailspetresorttx.com](https://www.happytailspetresorttx.com/reservation-requirements-cancellation-policy?utm_source=openai))

If your end-of-January dates fall on a **holiday period**, different terms apply: a **$150 deposit per Luxury Suite** is required, and you need to give **5 days’ notice** to avoid forfeiting the deposit. The policy doesn’t identify which specific dates count as holidays, so check with the resort about your dates. ([happytailspetresorttx.com](https://www.happytailspetresorttx.com/reservation-requirements-cancellation-policy?utm_source=openai))
